metadata.title: Regenerative Habitat Engineering: Building the Hearth
metadata.notes: Physical stewardship of the living space.

nodes.title: Bio-Materials & Carbon-Negative Building
nodes.description: Building with what is under your feet. Rammed earth, cob, and mycelium-based structural components. The thermodynamics of high-thermal-mass dwellings.

nodes.title: Kinetic Architecture & Passive Solar
nodes.description: Designing structures that move with the sun. Leveraging mechanical advantage for manual/automatic shade-tracking and passive heating optimization.

nodes.title: Passive Atmospheric Management
nodes.description: Engineering convection. Using Venturi effects and solar chimneys for zero-energy cooling and particulate-filtering ventilation. (Ref. mk0-clime).

nodes.title: The Hearth-Steward Capstone
nodes.description: Design and assemble a modular 'Spore Pod' (temporary workstation or shelter) that satisfies its own water and energy requirements for 7 days.

holonic_capstone.deliverable: A functioning modular habitat unit with verified thermal efficiency data broadcast to the mesh.

edges.rationale: Basic physics of energy and circuits is required for kinetic solar tracking.
Material sorting skills help identify useful aggregate for bio-material mixes.
One must master the materials before assembling the hearth.
